logline: Disguised as a common scullery maid, Lady Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and slips into the forbidden West Wing, where she discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from an unnatural, poisoned affliction.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 21 where Prudence revealed that the Dowager Duchess is dying from a mysterious illness; Juliana sets aside her aristocratic identity to sneak into Ashbury Manor under the guise of domestic help to save her.

events.description: Wide shot framing the gothic stone archway of Ashbury Manor as other maidservants carrying laundry baskets pass through the damp courtyard.
Lady Juliana walks nervously along the stone pavement dressed in a modest dark maid's dress and a plain white apron, looking around cautiously.

beats.scene_heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY

events.description: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana adjusting her high buttoned collar, anxious yet determined, against the backdrop of the gloomy coast.
Prudence rushes up behind Lady Juliana, pulling her into the shelter of the stone archway.
Keep your head down. If anyone recognizes you, everything is over.

beats.scene_heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY

events.description: Close-up of Lady Juliana leaning back against the rough stone wall, whispering back firmly.
No one will recognize me dressed like this.

beats.scene_heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY

events.description: Medium close-up of Prudence glancing nervously toward the courtyard before fixing her gaze on Juliana.
This is Ashburton Manor. The housekeeper watches everyone. Lady Catherine watches everyone, and Lord Rupert...

beats.scene_heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY

events.description: Close-up of Lady Juliana cutting in with fierce, unyielding conviction.
The Duchess is dying.

beats.scene_heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY

events.description: Low-angle shot looking up at Lady Juliana and Prudence standing beneath the looming stone facade of the manor.
I saved Toby. I can save her.

beats.scene_heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY

events.description: Close-up on Prudence, her eyes wide with dread.
And if they discover who you are?

beats.scene_heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY

events.description: Close-up on Lady Juliana holding her gaze steadily.
Then I will face that when she is breathing again.

beats.scene_heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY

events.description: Medium two-shot outside the heavy wooden servant entrance door.
Then forget you were ever a lady.

beats.scene_heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY

events.description: Close-up of Lady Juliana swallowing her pride and accepting her perilous disguise.
Today, I am only a maid.

beats.scene_heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY

events.description: Prudence opens the heavy wooden service door, and both women step inside into the dark servants' corridor as the door shuts firmly behind them.
Heavy wooden latch clicks shut with a thud.

beats.scene_heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVICE COURTYARD – DAY

events.description: Prudence.
Medium shot of the formidable Housekeeper standing in the dim stone hallway with arms folded, ring of keys dangling from her waist.
Who is this?

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Julian, ma'am. New help for the winter cleaning.
Medium shot of Prudence curtsying low with downcast eyes while Lady Juliana stands behind her carrying a heavy wooden water bucket.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Close-up profile of the Housekeeper sizing up Juliana critically.
She looks soft.
Close-up on Lady Juliana's hands gripping the iron handle of the wooden wash bucket firmly.
I can work, ma'am.
Close-up on Lady Juliana keeping her eyes dutifully lowered.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Low-angle shot of the Housekeeper staring down coldly.
Can you scrub stone?

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Yes, ma'am.
Close-up on Lady Juliana nodding slightly.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Carry coal?
Close-up of the Housekeeper's stern face.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Cut back to Lady Juliana maintaining her meek posture.
Yes, ma'am.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Profile medium two-shot as the Housekeeper steps right up into Lady Juliana's face, staring intently into her downcast eyes.
And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Extreme close-up on Lady Juliana's composed, lowered face.
Yes, ma'am.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Medium shot of the Housekeeper turning and pointing a bony finger toward the servant corridor stairs.
Then prove it. The manor has no use for useless girls.
The Housekeeper turns and stalks away down the corridor. Prudence exhales a trembling breath of relief.
Wide shot of the dimly lit hallway showing the Housekeeper walking away into the distance.
That was close.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Close-up on Lady Juliana clutching the wash bucket, her eyes scanning ahead urgently.
Where is the West Wing?

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Medium shot of Prudence pointing toward the archway leading toward the grand staircase.
Beyond the grand staircase. Few servants go there.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – SERVANTS' CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Tracking shot from behind Lady Juliana as she walks out into the vast, opulent marble hall of Ashbury Manor carrying her bucket.
Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.
Low-angle push-in on Lady Juliana looking up at the enormous portrait of the late Duke and Duchess hanging above the gallery.
This house...

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – GRAND ENTRANCE HALL – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.
Do not stare. Keep walking.
Medium close-up of Prudence whispering frantically into Juliana's ear.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – GRAND ENTRANCE HALL – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Wide tracking shot behind Lady Juliana as she hastens down the long marble gallery toward the secluded West Wing wing.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – GRAND ENTRANCE HALL – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Medium shot of Lady Juliana standing outside a massive carved mahogany door, glancing around the empty hallway to ensure she is unobserved.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.
Close-up of Lady Juliana's hand twisting the latch handle.
Faint, muffled click of the heavy door lock turning.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Slow tracking shot into the cavernous, shadowy bedchamber. In the center stands an ornate four-poster canopy bed draped in pale silk where a frail, silver-haired figure lies motionless.
Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.
Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.
Your Grace?
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped on pillows, her face gaunt, ashen, and drenched in cold sweat, her eyes half-fluttering.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Do not speak.
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana taking the Duchess's fragile, cold hands into her own.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Close-up of Lady Juliana checking the Duchess's pulse and gently pressing her fingertips against the Duchess's chest and neck, her herbalist instincts taking over.
Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.
This isn't ordinary fever.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – CONTINUOUS

events.description: The Dowager Duchess suddenly gasps violently for breath, convulsing weakly as her eyes snap open in agony.
Close-up of the Duchess gasping in sudden spasms.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Intense two-shot as Lady Juliana leans in close, gripping the Duchess's shoulder with urgent desperation.
Who has been treating you?

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – CONTINUOUS

events.description: Extreme close-up on the Dowager Duchess's terrified, wide eyes staring up as she chokes for air, the haunting realization of poison lingering as dramatic music hits an abrupt, suspenseful cliffhanger.

beats.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – CONTINUOUS
